name: Frederic Zeigner
original_name: フレデリク・ザイグナー
source:
Works together with werewolves. The person who sealed the werewolf. He looks like a child, but he has powerful legal powers.

Noticing the change in the world, he abandoned the church and went on a journey, where he met a werewolf.

[Translated from [url=http://www.moonparrot.com/html/game/soukoku/chara.html]official website[/url]]
